//: Repo-wide Claude config. Committed, so it holds only facts about THIS PROJECT — never anything about a particular machine, account or operator. Personal settings go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored), which loads after this file. NOTE: `deny` rules are deliberately kept out of this file — a deny cannot be loosened by a later settings source, so one placed here would be un-overridable locally. Put deny rules in settings.local.json.

hooks.command: changed=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); if echo "$changed" | grep -q "crates/tracecure-api/" && ! echo "$changed" | grep -q "docs/book/src/integration.md"; then echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"tracecure: crates/tracecure-api changed but docs/book/src/integration.md did not. That crate IS the wire contract - check the integration chapter still matches.\"}"; fi; exit 0
